stable.changelog:
- Rebrand application package to com.cumarull.apksignaturekiller
- Redesign Settings UI (Material 3, rounded cards, category headers)
- Add Update Channel picker (Stable / Beta)
- Add in-app update module (check / download / install) with rounded progress dialog
- Replace DexMerger with dexlib2 2.5.2 to fix BufferOverflow crash
- Remove vendored dx, filepicker and org.jf source modules
- Redesign Download progress dialog with percentage and rounded theme
- Update app title to "SignatureKill"
